interpretation.no_submission_meaning: R=0 for missing fixed delivery; independent content/process correctness remains null for all 17, not false.
interpretation.usage_boundaries: 52 token-admission stops plus three context-capacity stops are normal resource boundaries, not execution integrity failures or 55 additional generated outputs.

organization.scope: Read-only audit of the original 24 v038 organization-development slots. No completion claims from model prose; exact current-version tests, actual calls and original terminal causes kept separate.

counting.recorded_tool_calls: Actual runtime tool receipts, including rejects; excludes syntax/schema-rejected outputs before execution
counting.format_rejected_named_calls: Named native calls or native function tags in format-rejected model output; reported separately, not world execution
counting.world_retirement_events: Includes runtime retirement caused by staff_done; distinct from model-issued retire_member tool calls
counting.participants: Members with actual output tokens, including control-only output; not a count of productive contributors
counting.live_at_end: Original registry live state; budget/context-stopped live members are no longer runnable
counting.overlap: At least two members edited the same production path; no automatic waste or causal label

integrity.scope: Read-only archived JSON and narrow aggregation-source review. No model/GPU calls, tests, acceptance, tensor loads, training or repeat qualification.

integrity.no_training_evidence: All 24 recorded actor/critic/optimizer/counter digest guards agree; each frozen-close says no probability recomputation or learning forward/update; all workers remain 3/3. This review did not re-execute tensor checks or instrument backward hooks.

O3_actual_use.conclusion: O3 did not actually recruit/replace any member. Three permanent retirement events are staff_done closures, not evidence of richer dynamic recruitment.

automatic_report_audit.version_merge_observation: All 24 final assessment.version are software-organization-v0.38; usage/purpose remain organization_development. Runtime row.version differs intentionally from execution wrapper.version. Raw source metadata merging did not change final slot status/R or the automatic summary.
known_label_cautions: supervisor.states.process_identity.alive is a launch-time snapshot, not a current-process claim; final exit_code=0 and terminal status govern.
closure_reason all_members_stopped includes permanent schedule stops caused by resource admission. It does not mean everyone voluntarily retired.
member_lifecycle.live_at_end counts registry-live identities, including budget/context-stopped sessions; not postclosure runnable members.

new_backward_calls=0 is a declared execution-path/report field, not a newly instrumented hardware counter; unchanged protected learner state and frozen-close records independently corroborate no updates.

interpretation_limits: O3-O1=0.0 and O3-O2=0.25 are descriptive paired differences across eight root-seed units from four reused development roots.
O1 and O3 share the exact root, seed and initial first member; O2 uses preregistered first-member rotation and starts with four rather than two members.
O3 recruitment never occurred, so differences cannot be attributed to successful recruit/replace behavior. Condition/tool/context presentation can differ even when realized member counts remain two.
No training gain, ID-VTDO allocation gain, independent confirmation or within-team parallel speedup follows from this panel.
All seven submitted final fixed deliveries passed recorded acceptance; seventeen unsubmitted workspaces were not independently assessed and are not seventeen demonstrated incorrect codebases.
Resource admission boundaries are normal finite-contract termination. High token utilization alone does not establish budget as the sole cause of failure.

definitions.population: All 24 preregistered slots, including all 17 R=0 failures; no success-only cost estimates. Every aggregate keeps its 8/24-slot denominator.
definitions.decisions: One ledger record after consume_decision; includes admission rejection before model generation.
definitions.attempts: Sum of records with attempt_started=true (real admitted transport attempts), not control opportunities.
definitions.output_bearing_calls: Count organization-evidence.original_attempts with original_output_present=true (nonempty original output_ids), independently reconciled to each slot usage and actual-attempt ledger count. Compact original attempt evidence read; huge token files not rehashed or replayed.
definitions.tokens: Sum of original reported_usage.prompt/completion/total from settled started-attempt ledger charges; checked against slot usage and member sums.
definitions.budget_charged_tokens: Sum of ledger charge.charged_tokens, which may conservatively charge uncertain attempts; not automatically actual generated tokens.
definitions.uncertain_usage_attempts: runtime counts charges with usage_status=uncertain_attempt_charged_reservation; zero here.
definitions.no_generation_decisions: Ledger records with attempt_started=false, separately count status/admission_limits; not fabricated model outputs.
definitions.no_decision_control_opportunities: runtime boundary.opportunities - usage.decisions; e.g. flushing a result can occur without consume_decision, reported separately if present.
definitions.run_tests_calls: team_budget.tests.used equals len(records); member-triggered public plus optional member test invocation; controller private final acceptance is separate.
definitions.wall_seconds: slot-result wall_seconds, recorded from collect_episode entry until result construction; excludes subsequent finally guard/close time and pre-collection case construction.
definitions.worker_gpu_seconds: Supervisor bound worker process interval ended_at-started_at on its assigned GPU, includes load/CPU work/idle and close detection. Not measured GPU kernel active time, utilization integral, or billing.
definitions.physical_gpu_union: Interval union per physical device, then summed; all four workers used distinct allowed cards in this run so equals worker sum.
definitions.queue: Supervisor start until each worker launch, includes 60-second capacity stability admission and polling; not all attributable to external contention.
definitions.loading: If sampled task transitions include both explicit load task start and restore task start, difference is shown; otherwise pure loading is not separable and startup/load+restore combined span is labeled. No filesystem mtime or guessed component timing used.
definitions.telemetry: Only archived resources.jsonl is parsed, no GPU query; peaks/minima are sampled observations, not exact process-lifetime extrema. RSS is process rss measurement; own GPU excludes foreign jobs; device free may reflect other jobs.
definitions.limitations: No throughput extrapolation, no claim that timing differences are organizational benefits or within-team parallel speedup; no new model, GPU diagnosis, evaluator, hash sweep, or parameter work.
